headword: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません
reading: もうしわけございません
gloss: I am deeply sorry (very formal apology)

definitions.gloss: I am deeply sorry; I sincerely apologize
definitions.explanation: A very formal and polite way to apologize. More formal than 申し訳ありません, which is itself more formal than すみません. Used in business settings, customer service, and when speaking to superiors.

examples.japanese: {大変|たいへん}{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
お{待|ま}たせしてしまい、{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
examples.english: I am sorry to have kept you waiting.

examples.japanese: ご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけして{誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。{今後|こんご}このようなことがないよう{十分|じゅうぶん}{注意|ちゅうい}いたします。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I will take every care to ensure this does not happen again.

notes:
USAGE:
The most formal standard apology in modern Japanese. Used extensively in business, customer service, and formal correspondence. Often accompanied by a deep bow.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- すみません (casual-polite)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません (formal)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (very formal)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大変|たいへん}{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (I am terribly sorry)
- {誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (I sincerely apologize)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございませんが… (I'm sorry, but…) — used to make polite requests
